text:
maria: Kicking off canary for release `release/2026-03-21` — routing 5% traffic to the new runtime. Change window 10:00-14:00 PST. I'll watch SLOs for the next 15m. release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/2026-03-21 :eyes:

deploy-bot: Canary started — job=canary-2026-03-21-5pct, target=embeddings, routing=5% :rocket:

aj: Quick heads-up, looking at the SLO dashboard — embeddings.route p95 jumped to ~480ms at 1717554380, baseline ~260ms. Error rate also ticked from 0.08% -> 0.42% in the last 2m. link: https://obs.redwood/dashboards/slo/embed-route

vik: Can you paste the alert query? want to see the window and tags.

aj: Here — filtering by canary tag:
```
rate_errors = sum(rate(http_responses_total{route="/v1/embeddings",code!~"2..",deploy_tag="canary"}[5m]))
rate_reqs = sum(rate(http_requests_total{route="/v1/embeddings",deploy_tag="canary"}[5m]))
error_rate = rate_errors / rate_reqs
error_rate > 0.005
```

maria: Hmm, p95 climb + error blip within same minute. No other routes affected. Could be model variant or batching change. Any deploy logs?

deploy-bot: Logs uploaded to https://ci.redwood/logs/canary-2026-03-21/ (last index 1717554400). Summary: increased soft-batching window from 4ms -> 8ms for canary instances.

vik: That soft-batching tweak would explain latency but not immediate 5xxs. Are backends returning 502/504 or application 5xx?

aj: 5xx are mostly 502 with upstream grpc: "upstream connection reset by peer" in the trace samples.

maria: OK. My vote is pause traffic to canary and triage in the canary pool rather than force a whole-rollback. We can re-route the 5% to baseline while we debug.

sre-oncall: Agreed. If we drop to 0% quickly we avoid user impact. I'll set the policy: if error_rate > 0.5% for next 5m, roll full rollback. Else we reconvene.

aj: /deploy pause canary job=canary-2026-03-21-5pct — executed (requested by aj). :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Canary paused. Routing set to 0% for canary-2026-03-21-5pct. Traffic moved back to stable. Observability sampling increased for canary instances (traces enabled).

vik: While paused, can we hotfix by pinning embeddings model to `model:emb-v1.3.0` in the canary group and replay a small synthetic traffic job?

maria: I like that — less disruptive than rollback. aj can you run a replay with 1% synthetic load after pin applied.

aj: On it. Applying pin via config: `service.embeddings.model = "emb-v1.3.0"` and kicking off synthetic job.

deploy-bot: Config update applied to canary pool (config-change-1717554465). Starting synthetic-replay job=synthetic-verify-1717554470 at 10 rps for 2m.

aj: Replay metrics look clean so far — p95 ~270ms, errors ~0.02%. No 502s in traces.

sre-oncall: Good sign. Let's hold 10m and then resume a limited canary ramp to 2% for 10m before full rollout. If error_rate stays <0.1% continue ramp, else rollback.

maria: I'll update release notes and the deploy ticket: note about soft-batching change and model pin fallback. https://internal.redwood/tasks/REL-2026-03-21

vik: Also adding a todo to the postmortem: clearer coupling between batching config and model serving stack, plus a test harness to run regression for 4ms->8ms window changes.

aj: resuming canary ramp to 2% now. /deploy resume canary job=canary-2026-03-21-5pct target=2% (requested by aj).

deploy-bot: Canary ramped to 2%. Observability: SLO sampling set to high, alert window=5m.

maria: Monitoring will watch next 10m. SRE oncall will page if error_rate > 0.5% or p95 > 500ms.

sre-oncall: I'll stay on it. If anything spikes I have rollback procedure ready: `deploy-bot rollback canary-2026-03-21 --full`.

aj: For the release notes: adding a line: "Mitigation: pinned embeddings model to emb-v1.3.0 for canary instances after latency/502 spike during soft-batching change."

maria: Nice. If the 2% window stays green we can proceed to 10% after approval in 10m. For now marking the original canary run as "paused - mitigated" in the ticket. :spiral_notepad:

deploy-bot: Thread summary saved to REL-2026-03-21. Canary status: PAUSED->RAMPED(2%) after mitigation. Logs: https://ci.redwood/logs/canary-2026-03-21/1717554475

maria: Thanks team — excellent fast triage. I'll follow up with a brief postmortem action list after the window closes. :thumbsup:
